# layernorm-128: ccv-sim kernel.bin -threads 128 -cta -ctaid <cta>, followed by
# that CTA's pokes. One CTA of four warps a run, sharing .shared and the
# barriers; with the skeleton, the four warps' records are oracle.jsonl and
# oracle.<w>.jsonl. Results are checked exactly, or to a relative 1e-5 for its transcendentals (export-kernels.py).
